A light [[Color/Legends|green]]-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] worked as a '''part supplier''' on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="KOTOR2" /> during the [[Dark Wars]] in [[3951 BBY]].<ref name="CAMP" /> While attempting to deliver a part for a [[Unidentified Bith scientist|scientist's]] signal tracking equipment to the third docking pylon on the [[Nar Shaddaa Docks]], they were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Cleaning droid/Legends|cleaning droid]] within the pylon.<ref name="KOTOR2" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
[[Meetra Surik]], a former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]], discovered the Twi'lek's corpse when she arrived to pick up the part at the request of the [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]. After searching the [[Merchant/Legends|supplier's]] body and not finding the part, Surik was attacked by the same cleaning [[Droid/Legends|droid]]. Surik destroyed the droid and returned to the scientist without the part.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Twi'lek part supplier appeared in the [[2004]] [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''. Their appearance consists only of his corpse, which the player can examine during a side quest in the game.<ref name="KOTOR2" />
